title: Tell the family
drDigitalIntro:
Grandma should hear about this from you rather than from someone else.
There are no step-by-step instructions here. You get a list of things to accomplish and you decide how.
• Nothing glows yellow. No control is highlighted.
• Do the objectives in any order.
• Open the checklist with the small arrow in the dark bar to see what is left.
• The Hint button gives a nudge toward where to look — never the answer.

playgroundTask.goal: You told the family and started a group
playgroundTask.hint: A conversation opens by choosing who it is with. Starting a group is a different control from sending a message — look near the heading above the contact list.

steps.say: You are in a conversation with Grandma.
She has been told about the trip.
You reacted to something she said rather than replying in words.
The group has a message in it.

drDigitalSuccess: One conversation, one reaction, and a group of three. That is most of what messaging is.
drDigitalHint: Click a name to open that conversation. The control for starting a group sits beside the word Contacts.
